title: Foundation, governance, source baseline, and conformance bootstrap
summary: Created the independent MTM-reboot project, pinned Rust 1.98.0, established eight reversible milestones, froze Re-CTM 0.3.0 source facts, implemented machine-enforced governance/architecture/commit gates, and built a minimal Rust contract/CLI bootstrap without moving production authority.

failures_preserved.cause: The status JSON literal was passed directly as a Rust format string.
failures_preserved.correction: Separated the literal into a constant and printed it through a fixed format placeholder.

failures_preserved.cause: rustfmt rejected one trailing blank line in the contract library.
failures_preserved.correction: Removed the formatting-only difference and reran the whole gate.

failures_preserved.cause: A receipt-enforcement unit test still mutated the now-completed MTM-001 lifecycle and incorrectly emptied the actionable MTM-002 TODO.
failures_preserved.correction: Replaced the lifecycle-coupled fixture with a synthetic MTM-003 proposed-to-completed event chain while preserving the real project graph.

required_trailers.Manual-Pending: all later target/browser/CAS/LaTeX and migration acceptance

next.restriction: Only typed, side-effect-free contract and policy work may start; no storage, process, gateway, workflow, or finalizer authority may move.
